source.title: New results and new open problems and conjectures related to the chromatic number of the plane problem

trace.notes: Normalized the input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/8009525 for document identifier 8009525.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/8009525 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge. The zbMATH API resolved the exact record as Alexander Soifer's 2025 journal article 'New results and new open problems and conjectures related to the chromatic number of the plane problem', Zbl identifier 1569.05108, published in Geombinatorics 34, No. 3, pages 113-115. The API record contained bibliographic metadata and review text but no full-text links.

The Geombinatorics Volume XXXIV page confirmed the article's issue placement and page start in Issue 3, but exposed only the table of contents, not the article body or a downloadable full-text artifact.

Bounded exact-work recovery used exact-title, exact-title plus PDF, exact-title plus Geombinatorics, Crossref title search, OpenAlex title search, and the 2025 Southeastern International Conference abstract listing. Rejected candidates included the Springer/OpenAlex/Crossref records for the book 'The New Mathematical Coloring Book', searchable excerpts from that book, the WFNMC Mathematics Competitions PDF snippet, the FAU conference abstract entry with a related but nonidentical title, and unrelated search results because they are different works, snippets, abstracts, tables of contents, or bibliographic metadata rather than a readable copy of the Geombinatorics article.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, editorial review text, resolver records, abstracts, search snippets, citation-only pages, tables of contents, or different works. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-8009525.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
